=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:77-79 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The reported `clean()` function does not redact `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` before writing model-generated text to GitHub.
  WHY: A model response containing the key could expose it in public issue comments or bodies; z-ai_glm-5_2 reports that redaction is present and already fixed.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:621 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root guard's assignment-prefix parser does not recognize Bash `NAME+=value` assignments.
  WHY: A command such as `COUNT+=1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x` can bypass the merged-PR push guard, and the root and template hooks diverge.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py: lines 122-128 and lines 223-224 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `parse_entries()` retains carriage returns from CRLF issue bodies, causing strict equality verification against LF-rendered entries to fail.
  WHY: Upserts exhaust their attempts and raise an error, causing activation verification to skip the operator step.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:144-148 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The PR-files API fallback does not detect multi-commit rebase merges before using the merge diff.
  WHY: That diff can cover only the tip commit, so the verifier may grade an incomplete file set and miss activation gaps.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:134, 210-211 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The activation-fix marker matching does not trim a trailing carriage return before comparing the first line.
  WHY: CRLF issue bodies can prevent the marker from matching, causing an already-merged fix not to be recognized.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:243-252 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The reported comment assembly emits the terminal activation marker even when fix-issue lookup failed.
  WHY: The poller may treat verification as finalized and skip future runs despite code gaps not being filed.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:228, 249 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Non-idempotent GitHub POSTs for fix issues and verdict comments use `gh_retry`.
  WHY: If GitHub accepts a POST but its response is lost, a retry can create duplicate issues or comments.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:260-264 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The verifier unconditionally logs `outcome=posted` without reporting a partial outcome when fix-issue lookup fails.
  WHY: Operators and log analysis can receive a success signal even when no code-gap issue was created.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:580-581 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Activation-verdict deduplication does not strip trailing whitespace before checking whether a comment ends with the verdict marker.
  WHY: A comment with trailing whitespace can fail the `endswith()` check and cause activation verification to rerun.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:608-612 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The environment block launching project-mode `activation_verify.sh` omits `PROJECT_FILES_JSON`.
  WHY: When no final PR file list is available, the verifier defaults to `[]` and skips project activation verification with `reason=files_unavailable`.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh: lines 144-156 (PR-mode git-diff fallback) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: PR mode does not reject an empty changed-files array after its git-diff fallback.
  WHY: The verifier can ask the model to grade a merged PR with no changed files in its context instead of skipping unavailable or empty scope.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19514-19536 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Project activation verification is only called during completion transitions, so a failed fix-issue lookup that leaves a non-terminal comment is not retried on later polls.
  WHY: Completed projects are skipped before the verifier is called again, leaving activation verification unfinalized despite the documented retry behavior.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:179 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `upsert` does not fall back to reading a newly created issue by number when the label listing is stale.
  WHY: An eventually consistent listing can appear empty after creation and cause a duplicate operator-step issue to be created.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:218 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The upsert retry loop has no backoff between attempts.
  WHY: A transient API inconsistency can consume all attempts in a tight loop before the updated body becomes visible.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh: lines 162-166 (activation_files_json fallback in pr mode) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: PR mode does not verify that its fallback changed-files list is non-empty.
  WHY: The verifier can run Codex with an empty `changed_files` list rather than skipping when the file list is unavailable.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh: lines 235-244 (model invocation block) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The workflow passes `GH_TOKEN` into the job environment, and no test pins the script's `env -u` whitelist.
  WHY: The current override prevents model access to the token, but a future change to the whitelist could expose a write-capable token to the read-only-sandbox call.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:612-614 (after worktree remove) | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The project activation block does not clean up the runtime directory after removing the worktree.
  WHY: On a persistent self-hosted runner, runtime directories can accumulate across project completion cycles and cause disk pressure.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
